title: DNA sequence quantitatively encodes CTCF-binding affinity at genome scale
authors: Zihang Yin; Yefan Wang; Guojun Hou; Yuqiao Chen; Huaijin Feng; Jin Zhu; Yufan Xie; Ruoxi Wang; Zhiyu Zhang; Tao Wu; Haiyan Huang; Sheila Q. Xie; Wuming Wang; Wenchao Gu; Qiang Wu; Nan Shen; Ya Guo
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过大规模体外亲和力测量和深度学习模型DeepCTCF，定量解析DNA序列如何编码CTCF结合亲和力，核心聚焦TF-DNA互作与结合位点预测，方法为AI建模，高度匹配本课题。
abstract: CTCF is a central architectural protein that shapes 3D genome organization through sequence-specific DNA binding, but how DNA sequence quantitatively determines CTCF-binding strength remains poorly understood. Progress has been hampered by the lack of large, high-quality measurements of binding affinity. Here, we experimentally determine in vitro CTCF-binding affinity for 276,765 DNA sequences derived from the human genome, generating a comprehensive quantitative landscape of CTCF-DNA interactions. Leveraging these data, we develop DeepCTCF, a deep learning model that predicts CTCF-binding strength directly from DNA sequence and enables quantitative interpretation of CTCF motif grammar. Using this framework, we systematically dissect how specific sequence features modulate CTCF-binding affinity and generate quantitative predictions for disease-associated variants that alter CTCF binding. Together, this study defines general principles by which DNA sequence encodes CTCF-binding affinity and provides a quantitative framework for interpreting regulatory sequence variation. Teaser Mapping how DNA encodes CTCF binding reveals quantitative rules across over 1‰ of the human genome.
abstract_zh: CTCF是一种核心结构蛋白，通过序列特异性DNA结合塑造三维基因组组织，但DNA序列如何定量决定CTCF结合强度仍知之甚少。这一进展一直受到缺乏大规模、高质量结合亲和力测量的阻碍。在此，我们实验测定了来自人类基因组的276,765个DNA序列的体外CTCF结合亲和力，生成了CTCF-DNA相互作用的全面定量景观。利用这些数据，我们开发了DeepCTCF，一种深度学习模型，可直接从DNA序列预测CTCF结合强度，并实现对CTCF基序语法的定量解读。通过这一框架，我们系统剖析了特定序列特征如何调节CTCF结合亲和力，并为改变CTCF结合的疾病相关变异生成定量预测。总之，本研究定义了DNA序列编码CTCF结合亲和力的一般原则，并为解读调控序列变异提供了定量框架。摘要：绘制DNA编码CTCF结合的图谱，揭示了人类基因组超过千分之一区域的定量规则。
